caption:
Long, padded answers? Give the AI limits. ✂️

Try: "Answer in under 80 words. No intro, no summary. Use plain words."
Limits make answers shorter and easier to use.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #aitools #promptengineering #aitips #prompts #productivity #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: Why is every AI answer so long?
scenes.say: Why is every AI answer so long? Because you did not set limits.

scenes.title: Add limits to your ask
scenes.user: Explain cloud storage in under 60 words. No intro, no summary.
scenes.reply:
Cloud storage keeps your files on remote servers.
You reach them from any device with internet.
You pay for space, not hardware.
scenes.say: Try this. Explain cloud storage in under sixty words. No intro, no summary. Now you get just the useful part.

scenes.title: Limits that work
scenes.say: Three limits that work. Set a word count. Say no intro and no summary. And name the format, like three bullets.
Without limits, you get padding. With limits, you get a short answer you can use right away.
